translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Karaiwogala yam Sabate
Mosese ikouguguli komwaidosi mina Isireli e iluki matausina kawala, “Ka, baisa makawala Guyau eikaraiwogaimi bukuvagaisi.

Mi yam kwailima kwaitala paila bukuvagaisi mi paisewa, mitaga yam kwailima kwaiyuwela ibodi bukukwabomaisi, yam makwaina kami yamveka wala bukuuvaiwasisi, deli bukukwabomaisi paila yeigu Guyau. E availa bivagi avai paisewa wa yam makwaina, ibodi wala bukukwatumataisi.
Gala goli bukuvakatasi kova omi valu yam Sabate.”
Semakavi paila Bwala Kwebumaboma
Mosese iluki komwaidosi mina Isireli kawala, “Ka, baisa makawala Guyau eikaraiwogaimi.
Ibodi bukusemakavaisi baisa Guyau. Mapaila availa availa magisi bisemakavaisi, ibodi bimaiyaisi si semakavi goula, kaina siliba, kaina barasi;
kaina karekwa yakakalaia eiyoudulaisi metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu deli bweyani; kaina karekwa eibisikaisi metoya gota unuunula,
kaina sipi nammwala unuunisi eilaleisi bweyani; kaina mauna kanuvinela; kaina meku,
kaina kevakeva paila kaitapa; kaina vana paila vaputuma bulamila deli paila lula maiina simasimina;
kaina dakuna kaneliani isim mapula mwau, kaina avai veiguwa tuvaila paila bisailasi omatala miyana epodi yabumaboma eisisikoma Tolula Toveka deli okala kuwa.
Guguwala Guyau la Buliyoyova
“Ka, availa availa matausina tokataraki youdila oluwalaidasi, ibodi biyoudulaisi vavagi komwaidona avaka Guyau bogwa eikaraiwogi.
Ka makwaina Buliyoyova, miyasina katuvala, deli miyasina bivakalupoli, makaisina kokola deli kala kailasau, mabubosina poula, makaisina kokolela, deli makwaisina ulilaguvala;
e makwaina Kabutu Didawogala, deli mabubosina katikewala, mapilana katubukolela, deli miyana tabodala makwaina,
makwaina tebeli, mabubosina katikewala, deli komwaidona makwaisina guguwala; deli makwaisina beredi tavigakaisi lula baisa Yaubada;
e kabototu paila kaitapa deli makwaisina guguwala; e makaisina kaitapa deli kevakevasi,
e kabogwabu lula paila lula maiina simasimina deli mabubosina katikewala; vaputuma bulamila; vavagi maiina simasimina; e miyana tabodala Buliyoyova kala lulu;
kabogwabu lula makwaina paila lula kwegubugabu, deli kaivalela barasi olumoulela, katikewala deli komwaidona guguwala; makaina kailuya kabowina deli la kabototu;
miyasina taboda paila papala, kokolela deli ulilaguvala; miyana taboda paila lulu tabodala;
makaisina kenubiluma deli yuwoyoulela Buliyoyova deli papala,
deli miyasina yammatabwaila kwama paila tolula bisisikamsi avai tuta biwotitalaigusi olumoulela matabudona Bomikikila - miyasina kwama yabumaboma paila tolula Eroni deli goli litula.”
Mina Isireli imaiyaisi si semakavi
E komwaidosi mina Isireli ibutusi,

mapaila availa availa magisi bisemakavaisi, matausina isemakavaisi baisa Guyau paila kala kaliai la Buliyoyova. E matausina imaiyaisi komwaidona avaka bibudoki paila tapwaroru wotitalela deli tolula kasi kwama bibisikaisi.

E komwaidosi availa magisi bisemakavaisi tauwau deli vivila, imaiyaisi si semakavi vasia isim kasi katububula, paya, kakalougwa, kuwekuwa, deli goli katububula ituwoli ituwoli eibubulokaisi metoya goula e ikabomaisi komwaidona makwaisina baisa Guyau.

E availa availa matausina iyosisi karekwa yakakalaia eiyoudulaisi metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu, kaina bweyani, karekwa eibisikaisi gota unuunusi, kaina sipi nammwala kanuvinesi eilalaisi bweyani; kaina mauna kanuvinesi yamatabwaila, imaiyaisi wala.
Komwaidona availa availa ibodi bisemakavaisi siliba, kaina barasi, imaiyaisi si semakavi baisa Guyau, deli availa availa iyosisi meku paila bibudoki avai youdila tuvaila ivigakaisi si semakavi.
Komwaidosi nunumoya minasina nakatavatu youdila imaiyaisi wotunula karekwa yakakalaia, deli wotunu metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu, deli bweyani, miyasina goli leibisikaisi yumasi.
E tuvaila minasina iviraisi wotunu metoya gota unuunula.
E matausina tokaraiwaga imaiyaisi dakuna kaneliani deli avai veiguwa tuvaila paila bipakaisi otapwala miyana epodi yabumaboma deli goli mapilana kuwekuwa pilapatata.
Tuvaila imaiyaisi bulami deli kevakeva paila makaisina kaitapa, deli vana paila vaputuma bulamila, deli paila lula maiina simasimina.
E komwaidosi mina Isireli availa availa magisi bisemakavaisi baisa Guyau, matausina isemakavaisi paila wotetila makwaina Guyau leikaraiwogi Mosese bivagi.
Guyau la Buliyoyova kala toyoudila
Mosese iluki mina Isireli kawala, “Guyau bogwa einagi Besaleli matauna Uri latula e tabula Ura, metoya odalela Yuda.
Yaubada la peula bogwa eivakasau matauna deli isaiki la katavatu, la kabitam tuvaila la ninitalapula paila kala katuginigini youdila kwaitala kwaitala,
deli bininamsi ammakawala leilai kala kimadagi e bikatuginigini goula, siliba, deli barasi,
tuvaila veiguwa kala titavisi deli bikibuboti, deli paila bilaleya kai; deli goli kala katuginigini avai leilai avai leilai.
Guyau bogwa leisaiki si kabitam, matauna deli Owoliabi matauna Aisamaki latula metoya odalela Dani, paila biyomitalaisi si katavatu paila youdila baisa sesia.

E Guyau bogwa leisaiki matausina si katavatu paila bivagaisi komwaidona paisewa makwaisina totaisi dakuna leiuvagaisi, deli toleilai, toviriviri karekwa yakakalaia, wotunu leiyoudulaisi metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu deli bweyani deli goli avai karekwa wala. Matausina ibodi bivagaisi avai youdila wala, paila matausina saina tokatavatu katuginigini.
